SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.
   B. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   D. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Fishing in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing in Eastern Africa.
   B. Treat Fishing in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Fishing in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Fishing in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Name the president

4. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   B. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.
   C. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

6. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   C. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.

7. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.
   B. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   C. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   C. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Beef Farming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Transport in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
